name: help-square
useCase: Open contextual help for a labeled field or setting.
misuse: Do not use the question mark alone to report an error or describe a control to assistive technology.

16.reason: The same small question curve as help-circle stays separate from its dot and square frame by at least 1px.

24.reason: The original larger question curve and dot retain at least 1.5px of space inside the unchanged square frame.
